mapper.sql: id, platform, version_code, version_name, force_update, min_version_code, download_url, update_content, domain, plugin_config_url, splash_image_url, splash_image_md5, enabled, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_app_version WHERE platform = #{platform} AND enabled = 1 ORDER BY version_code DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_app_version ( id, platform, version_code, version_name, force_update, min_version_code, download_url, update_content, domain, plugin_config_url, splash_image_url, splash_image_md5, enabled, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{platform}'android', #{versionCode}, #{versionName}, #{forceUpdate}0, #{minVersionCode}0, #{downloadUrl}, #{updateContent}, #{domain}, #{pluginConfigUrl}, #{splashImageUrl}, #{splashImageMd5}, #{enabled}1, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
